slate_building.settings.modes.airDistanc: How far away a corner placed on air sits. The build menu has the same slider under a mode's options.
slate_building.settings.modes.confirmWit: A third right-click applies the selection. When off, use the Confirm key (right-click still works while that key is unbound).
slate_building.settings.modes.livePrevie: Show the result while the box still follows your crosshair (small selections only).
slate_building.settings.modes.labels.des: Show the size of the selection above it in the world.
slate_building.settings.modes.arrowNudge: Arrow keys move the selection one block; Shift, Page Up and Page Down move it vertically.
slate_building.settings.modes.escapeCanc: With a selection pending, Esc clears it instead of opening the pause menu (the mode stays on). The cancel key (Q) always does.
slate_building.settings.modes.openContai: With nothing selected, right-clicking a chest or barrel opens it instead of starting a selection.
